verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for bulk-exporting all account data in open formats to support leaving Datadog. OpenTelemetry support covers ingesting data in an open standard, not exporting it out. The API reference and the ClickHouse logs integration are at most developer building blocks or adjacent features, and neither describes a full data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
